removing-discontinuity-k.alt: Two graphs of f(x) = kx + 1 for x < 2 and f(x) = x² − 1 for x ≥ 2. Left, with k = 2, the line reaches an open circle at (2, 5) while the parabola starts at a closed dot at (2, 3): a jump. Right, with k = 1, the line reaches (2, 3) exactly where the parabola starts, so the pieces meet and f is continuous at 2. The condition is 2k + 1 = 3, so k = 1.
